domainFacts: CAA Dataverse SchemaNames use single-word PascalCase per the team convention (fsi_PolicyId, fsi_ValidationTime). Logical names are the SchemaNames lowercased (fsi_policyid, fsi_validationtime). Underscored snake_case SchemaNames were corrected in v2.0.0 (Issue #36) — see CHANGELOG for migration steps.

The export script and all OData consumers reference fsi_overallseverity (logical name of fsi_OverallSeverity Picklist) consistently as of v2.0.0. CAAClient.psm1 retains a defensive fallback to fsi_overallstatus for backward compatibility with pre-v2.0 callers; new code MUST use fsi_overallseverity. Filter with integer comparison against fsi_acv_severity option values (100000000–100000004), not string.

Get-ZoneClassification.ps1 column names verified against the ELM solution's create_elm_dataverse_schema.py: fsi_environmentid (string, logical name of fsi_EnvironmentId) and fsi_zone (picklist, logical name of fsi_Zone) on the fsi_environmentrequests entity set. Zone option values are 100000001=Zone1, 100000002=Zone2, 100000003=Zone3. The script also reads the OData formatted-value annotation so an ELM-side option-set rename does not break zone resolution.
All 9 CA policy templates use v1.0 Graph API schema and include break-glass account exclusions. Templates target Control 1.11 specifically via _metadata.targetControl.
The CA WhatIf evaluation endpoint (graph.microsoft.com/beta/identity/conditionalAccess/evaluate) is beta-only with no GA commitment.
